name: Coinley – Cryptocurrency Payments
author: coinley

sections.description:
Note: This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Coinley enables your WooCommerce store to accept stablecoin payments (USDC and USDT) across 9 blockchain networks with direct wallet-to-wallet settlement.

Benefits

  • Low Fees: 1% transaction fee (vs. traditional 2.9% + $0.30)
  • Instant Settlement: Funds arrive directly in your wallet
  • No Chargebacks: Irreversible blockchain transactions
  • Multi-Chain Support: Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, Celo, and Solana
  • 100+ Wallets Supported: MetaMask, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet, Trust Wallet, and more

Features

  • Seamless checkout experience
  • USDC and USDT stablecoin payments
  • Real-time payment verification
  • WooCommerce Blocks support
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
  • Mobile-friendly via WalletConnect
  • Test mode for sandbox testing

Support

For support, visit Coinley Support or email support@coinley.io.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce
  2. Install and activate Coinley plugin
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Coinley
  4. Enter your API credentials from Coinley.io
  5. Save and start accepting crypto payments
sections.faq:
Do I need a Coinley account?

Yes, create a free account at Coinley.io to get your API credentials.

Which cryptocurrencies are supported?

USDC and USDT stablecoins on 9 networks: Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, Celo, and Solana.

What are the fees?

Coinley charges 1% per transaction with no monthly fees or setup costs.

Can I test before going live?

Yes, the plugin includes a test mode for sandbox transactions.
sections.changelog:
1.1.5

  • Added: HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility
  • Added: WooCommerce Checkout Blocks support
  • Added: Public key authentication system
  • Improved: Security hardening with proper sanitization, escaping, and capability checks
  • Improved: Debug logging now respects WordPress debug settings
  • Updated: Minimum PHP requirement to 7.4
  • Updated: Minimum WordPress requirement to 6.4
  • Updated: WooCommerce 8.0+ and 9.4 compatibility
  • Fixed: Version consistency across plugin files

1.1.3

  • Improved: Enhanced error handling for transaction details API endpoint
  • Fixed: Better error messages when API returns 500 errors
  • Fixed: More descriptive error feedback when payment details cannot be fetched
  • Updated: API field name corrections for merchant statistics endpoint

1.0.0

  • Initial release
